newsitem.title: INDIA: India TELCO Q1 sales 18.8 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India TELCO Q1 sales 18.8 bln rupees.

text.p: Sales of truck and equipment maker Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company Ltd (TELCO) totalled 18.80 billion rupees in the first quarter of 1997/98 (April-March), chairman Ratan Tata said on Wednesday.
Exports in the first three months to June 30 were $17.74 million, he told shareholders at the company's annual general meeting.
He said sales were down more than 10 percent and exports 38 percent from the same period a year ago, but did not give comparisons.
Earlier, a company spokeswoman told Reuters that sales had fallen 12.5 percent in the first quarter of 1997/98.
